pi-lead.label: Pi Lead
pi-lead.description: Orchestration owner. Gets full Paseo MCP; bounded by AGENTS.md and the policy extension.

pi-worker.label: Pi Worker
pi-worker.description: Bounded implementation agent. No Paseo MCP; write authority comes only from the current-turn Task Brief.

pi-reviewer.label: Pi Reviewer
pi-reviewer.description: Independent review. No Paseo MCP; behaviorally read-only on an exact candidate SHA or the current working diff.

pi-supervisor.label: Pi Supervisor
pi-supervisor.description: Governance observer. Gets a read-only allowlist of Paseo MCP tools; instruction-gated recovery only.
